messages:
Alyssa: FYI customer OmniCart reported ~15% 504s and p95 request timeouts hitting hosted API since 09:28 UTC. Customer says problems started after a large bulk import. Escalating to incidents.

Jordan: Thanks. Any repro req ids or sample traces? Is this concentrated to a tenant or global?

Alyssa: Tenant-scoped, tenant_id=omnicart-prod. Sample request ids: req_01GZ1, req_01GZ2. They said the shape is many short parallel requests, ~1-2k RPS briefly.

Evan: Pulling ingress metrics now. I see request_queue_depth spiking for omnicart-prod around 09:27 and continuous-batcher backlog rising. p50/p95 token generation fine, p99 escalates. Looks like enqueue rate > dequeue capacity + batching warmup.

Mike: Can you paste the controller logs around the spike? I want to see queue rejections and any early rejects.

Evan: Paste of relevant logs:
```
2026-02-12T09:27:31Z INFO enqueue tenant=omnicart-prod queue_depth=512
2026-02-12T09:27:32Z WARN batcher.backlog tenant=omnicart-prod backlog=1200 pending_batches=18
2026-02-12T09:27:33Z ERROR request.reject tenant=omnicart-prod reason=queue_depth_limit queue_limit=512 current_depth=520
2026-02-12T09:27:34Z WARN kvcache.kv_miss tenant=omnicart-prod miss_rate=0.38
2026-02-12T09:27:35Z ERROR http 504 tenant=omnicart-prod req=req_01GZ1 path=/v1/generate latency_ms=60000
```

Sophia: That looks like queue depth clipping. Continuous batching warmup + many small requests caused a backlog; kernel selection didn't scale fast enough for short seqs.

Jordan: Any auth or billing anomalies? Could auth failures have been amplifying retries?

Alyssa: Billing fine, auth tokens validated. Customer did note client retried aggressively on 504s, which likely worsened the pileup.

Mike: Repro steps from support for eng: they ran a replay to our hosted endpoint with the following script to simulate the pattern:
```bash
# simulate many concurrent short requests
for i in {1..2000}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $OMNI_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"short","max_tokens":8}' &
done
wait
```

Evan: I can repro locally in staging with a smaller cluster footprint. Example trace: queue_depth increases, continuous-batcher creates many small batches, allocator backs off, dequeue throughput drops.

Jordan: Short term mitigation options?

Sophia: Immediate: enable tenant soft-throttle to shed excess inflight and avoid queue limit rejects. Also bump queue_depth limit for omnicart-prod by +256 for next 30m as emergency.

Mike: I pushed a targeted config: 
- tenant.soft_throttle=on for omnicart-prod
- tenant.queue_depth_limit=768 (was 512)
Applied at 09:42 UTC.

support-bot: Incident update: emergency config applied (change_id=cfg_20260212_0942). Monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:

Alyssa: Customer reporting immediate improvement, 504 rate dropped to <0.5% and p95 latency returned to baseline within 6m. They did see a few client-side retries during the window.

Jordan: Good. Root cause analysis notes: workload pattern (many small concurrent short-gen requests) + continuous-batcher warmup + cold kernel scaling + kvcache miss spike. That combo created transient queue saturation.

Evan: Follow-ups I suggest:
- Add a batching warmup heuristic: pre-allocate more batcher slots for sudden high enqueue rates for short sequences.
- Improve tenant-specific admission control: auto-soft-throttle triggers earlier based on enqueue rate derivative.
- Add a metric alert: tenant_queue_depth_rate_of_change > threshold.

Sophia: Ops/runbook: when tenant queue_depth spikes and backlog>batcher_threshold -> enable soft_throttle + optionally bump queue_limit if tenant has committed capacity.

Mike: Created ticket INF-5792 for the batching warmup heuristic + INF-5793 for auto admission control. Assign to eng-runtime and eng-infra.

Alyssa: Noting customer follow-up: schedule a postmortem and share mitigation steps + recommend client backoff policy to avoid retry amplification.

Jordan: Flagging to product: consider adding tenant-level burst controls and a documented recommended client retry/backoff.

support-bot: Post-incident checklist: 1) config change documented (cfg_20260212_0942). 2) tickets INF-5792, INF-5793 created. 3) customer notified. 4) monitoring rule created: queue_depth_roc_alert.

Alyssa: Closing thread for now. Will reopen if any regression. Thanks all. :pray:
